Dear City Lords, Revival and Exploration will be maintenance and update on May 29th, 2025. Please be informed!

3.Fixed abnormal effects of the [Unbounded] state in certain scenarios.
4. Corrected an issue where Island Treasure Chests were not counting toward quest progress.
